query:
SELECT (listened_at AT TIME ZONE $4)::date AS "date!", count(*) AS "listens!"
             FROM listen
            WHERE profile_id = $1 AND listened_at >= $2 AND listened_at < $3
              AND ($5::text IS NULL OR listen_source(client) = $5)
            GROUP BY 1
            ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1
            LIMIT 1
